ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: 0.05:1; the visible surface is predominantly composed of low-intensity pixels (dark grey/black) with high-intensity (white) clusters making up less than 5% of the total fluke area.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive white circular ring-scar located mid-lobe on the left side, providing a unique high-contrast focal point against the dark pigmentation.
